{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Keep only the latest (highest sample_seq) row per patient
df = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = df.isnull().sum()

# Check for sentinel values (e.g., -999.0 in biomarker_baseline)
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0).sum()

# Check distributions of key variables
print("Missing values:")
print(missing_values)

print(f"\nSentinel value (-999.0) count in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}")

print("\nSex distribution:")
print(df['sex'].value_counts())

print("\nSeverity distribution by arm:")
print(pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['severity']))

print("\nAge distribution by sex:")
print(df.groupby('sex')['age'].describe())

print("\nResponded rate by sex:")
print(df.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean())"}
